_meta.purpose: Every grenade blueprint with its parameters and what each kind does, for the brain's grenade rules (BACKLOG B33). Regenerate with tools/build_grenade_catalog.py.
_meta.confidence: numbers: [verified in the game XML]; per-kind notes carry their own tags
_meta.note: min_safe_dist is the brain's own floor (a distance in tiles from the thrower, a guess where marked), not an engine value; None = no floor needed beyond the engine's radius

gas.area: A cloud: the thrown cell and its adjacent cells receive the gas (GasGrenade.DoDetonate creates a Gas object in each of them, `[verified in code]`), then it spreads by itself every turn: above density 10 a 25 percent chance to move into 1-4 neighbours, at 10 or less a 50 percent chance to vanish; non-seeping gas stays in corridors for hundreds of turns `[wiki]`. No fixed radius.
hazards: the cloud drifts back toward the thrower and into corridors and rooms
companions and the thrower take the effect too

thermal.area: A blast around the thrown cell: the cell and its neighbours get a TemperatureChange of TemperatureDelta (ThermalGrenade.DoDetonate uses GetAdjacentCells, `[verified in code]`); the wiki gives the freeze grenade a blast radius of 2 and a freeze grenade froze its thrower at 2 tiles `[verified in game 2026-10-10]`, so the radius is treated as 2.
hazards: cold freezes creatures solid and turns water to ice
heat ignites grass, plants, oil and flammable creatures and starts fires that spread
the thrower is hit at 2 tiles or less

he.area: An explosion: HEGrenade.DoDetonate calls Explode(Force); force falls off cell by cell, reduced by the weight of what it hits, until it is about 100, so the reach depends on the surroundings `[wiki]`. Damage is Force/250 plus dice. No fixed radius; open ground reaches farthest.
hazards: damages and pushes everything, including the thrower and companions
walls and objects absorb force; whether they are damaged is unknown `[unverified]`

emp.area: Radius from the part (EMPGrenade.DoDetonate calls EMP(radius, duration), `[verified in code]`); disables electronics, powered items and robots for the duration, and can hit the thrower's own cybernetics and devices `[unverified]`.
hazards: a thrower with cybernetics or powered gear inside the radius is affected `[unverified]`

flashbang.area: Radius from the part (FlashbangGrenade.DoDetonate calls Flashbang(radius, duration)); blinds creatures that can see it for the duration `[verified in code]`.
hazards: blinds the thrower and companions that see the flash `[unverified]`

gravity.area: Radius from the part: the grenade implodes and pulls creatures toward the centre with Force and ForceDropoff (GravityGrenade.DoDetonate: Fall, Accelerate; needs usable reality distortion), `[verified in code]`.
hazards: pulls the thrower and companions in too if they are inside the radius
fails where reality distortion is stabilized (a normality gas cloud, the Ontological Anchor)

sunder.area: Radius 3 from the part: SunderGrenade.DoDetonate calls Disintegrate (it destroys things in the radius; the effect on creatures and walls is unknown), `[verified in code]` for the call, `[unverified]` for the effect.
hazards: could destroy the thrower's own items or walls nearby `[unverified]`

time_dilation.area: A time-dilation field (TimeDilationGrenade.DoDetonate calls ApplyField with Range and Level), `[verified in code]`; the effect is the Time Dilation mutation's: affected creatures act on a different clock `[unverified]`.
hazards: slows or speeds whoever is inside, which may include him `[unverified]`

phase.area: Radius 2: creatures in the adjacent cells are phased out of the world for the duration (PhaseGrenade.DoDetonate: ForceApplyEffect), needs usable reality distortion, `[verified in code]`.
hazards: a phased creature cannot be hit, and cannot hit; the thrower may be phased too

deployment.area: Places objects around the thrown cell within Radius: microturrets loyal to the thrower for the fire support grenade, a stasis field for the stasis grenade (DeploymentGrenade: Blueprint, Count, Radius, Duration), `[verified in code]`.
hazards: a stasis field freezes everything inside it, the thrower included if close
microturrets are loyal to the thrower: an ally

gases.AcidGas: damages creatures and their equipment with acid each turn (not items lying on the ground: ExcludeTag Item); the wiki lists corrosive gas as seeping through walls but the XML sets no Seeping `[conflict, unverified]`
gases.PoisonGas: poisons creatures that breathe (a respiration gas) and damages them
gases.SleepGas: puts creatures that breathe to sleep (involuntary sleep, a save against density)
gases.DefoliantGas: damages live plants, photosynthetic skin, and plant-based equipment and cybernetics; seeps through walls; harmless to most creatures
gases.FungicideGas: damages live fungi and fungal infections; seeps through walls
gases.NormalityGas: stabilizes reality: damages entropic and extradimensional creatures and blocks reality-distortion abilities in the cloud (teleporting, phasing, gravity grenades); seeps through walls
gases.GlitterGas: glittering dust that refracts light (light-based attacks scatter); no damage
gases.Plasma: damages with plasma and coats in plasma (heat); seeps through walls; creatures take a hundredth of the item damage
